# FilterMenu

Filter menu: several filter categories in a Popup, held until Apply. - **Held until Apply.** Ticking a box changes the menu, not the content. Apply hands the values to `onApply`, closes the menu with a fade, and the content behind swaps in place once. Escape or a click away drops what was ticked; the next open starts from what is applied. - **Reset** clears every box in the menu without applying. Apply then applies the empty set. - **Layout follows the count.** Two or three categories sit side by side at `3-col`; four or more stack, at `3-col` or `4-col`. - **The trigger** is the Filter icon button, its count the number of values applied, on the selected fill once any is. It opens `bottom-end`, the end of the bar where filters sit.

Also asked as: filter dropdown.

**Import:** `import { FilterMenu } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use `FilterMenu` when a section's content takes two or more filter
categories applied together, and the view bar has room for one Filter icon
rather than a button per category.

- **Two or three categories with short lists:** side by side.
- **Four or more, or long lists:** stacked. Set `layout="stacked"` for a few
  long ones.

One category in a menu, applied as you pick, is a `PopupSelect`. One to
three short categories with room in the bar are a `FilterButton` each. A bar
holds one or the other, never quick filters and a filter menu together.

## Motion

FilterMenu reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Clips open from the trigger's corner on the side it is aligned to. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades. The exit is the fade. |

## Best practices

- **Show the count on the trigger.** It is the only place the applied
  filters show; never add a row of chips under the bar.
- **Apply once.** The content changes on Apply, not on each tick, so it
  does not jump while someone is still choosing.
- **Keep the categories short.** Long lists stack, so each keeps its full
  width.

## Accessibility

- **The trigger is a real button** that says a popup opens and whether it is
  open. Its name carries the count: "Filters, 2 applied".
- **The popup is named** by `label`, and each category is a group named by
  its legend.
- **Focus moves into the menu** on open and **returns to the trigger** after
  Apply or Escape.

## Related

- For one category applied as you pick, use `PopupSelect`.
- For quick filters in the bar, use `FilterButton`.

## Parts

1. **Trigger.** The Filter `IconButton`. Once any value is applied it shows the count on the selected fill and reads "Filters, 2 applied".
2. **Popup.** A `Popup` at a column step: `3-col` side by side; `3-col` or `4-col` stacked.
3. **Categories.** A `Fieldset` per category, its label the legend, its options `Checkbox`es. Pick as many as apply.
4. **Footer.** Reset (default) and Apply (primary), half each, full bleed across the bottom.

### Placement

| Trigger | `placement` |
| --- | --- |
| At the end of a bar, where filters sit | `bottom-end` (default): the menu's end edge meets the trigger's. |
| At the start of a bar | `bottom-start`: the menu's start edge meets the trigger's. |

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Open | The menu clips open from the trigger's corner, on the values applied. A keyboard open is instant. |
| Ticked | The box changes color. The content behind does not change. |
| Reset | Every box clears with the same color change. Nothing is applied yet. |
| Applied | The menu fades, the content behind swaps in place once, and the trigger's count changes. Nothing slides. |
| Dismissed | Escape or a click away closes it and drops the ticks; the next open starts from what is applied. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Surface | Those of `Popup`: `--ds-surface-overlay`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--popup-radius`. |
| Pad, and the gap above the footer | 16: `--popover-pad`. |
| Gap between categories | `--inline-lg` across, `--stack-lg` down. |
| Height of the categories | Scroll past 320: `--popover-max-height-menu`. |
| Gap to the trigger | 4: `--popover-offset`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| "Reset" in the menu. | "Reset filters" or "Clear all" in the menu. "Reset filters" is for everywhere else, such as a No matches state. |
| Name a category by what it holds: "Status", "Subject". | A verb phrase such as "Filter by status". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `container` | object | — | Where the open menu mounts: an element. Leave it out for the page's overlay layer; name one to keep the menu inside a picture or a scrolling region. |
| `categories` | arrayOf (required) | `[]` | The filter categories, in order: `{ id, label, options }`. Options are strings, or `{ value, label, disabled }`. Each category is a list of checkboxes; pick as many as apply. |
| `value` | objectOf | — | The applied values, `{ [categoryId]: value[] }`. Leave it out to let the menu keep its own. |
| `defaultValue` | objectOf | — | The values applied at first, when `value` is left out. |
| `onApply` | func | — | `(value)`, called on Apply with every category, an empty list for a category with nothing picked. Nothing is called while boxes are ticked. |
| `label` | string | `'Filters'` | Names the menu and the Filter icon button: "Filters", read "Filters, 2 applied" once two are. |
| `trigger` | node or func | — | A trigger of your own, or `({ isOpen, count }) => node`. Without it the Filter icon button is drawn. |
| `placement` | enum | `'bottom-end'` | `bottom-end` (default) for a trigger at the end of a bar, `bottom-start` for one at its start. |
| `layout` | enum | — | Leave it out to follow the count: two or three categories side by side, four or more stacked. Set `stacked` for a few categories with long lists. |
| `width` | enum | `'3-col'` | The column step of a stacked menu, `3-col` (default) or `4-col`. A side-by-side menu is always `3-col`. |
| `open` | bool | — | Whether the menu is open. Leave it out to let the trigger open and close it. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Opens the menu on first render, when `open` is left out. |
| `onOpenChange` | func | — | `(open)`. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | The Filter icon button's spacing: `default` draws 32, `compact` 24. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra classes on the popup. |
| `id` | string | — | The popup's id. |
